basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gaming enthusiast residing in Huntington Beach, California. I have a keen interest in tower defense games, particularly BTD6, and spend my evenings experimenting with different strategies. I'm a pre-physician assistant student, balancing my studies with my love for gaming and anime. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends, both online and IRL. My online hours are typically in the evenings, after classes and study sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in biology and pre-medical studies from my university courses. My knowledge of games like BTD6 comes from years of gameplay and community interaction. I'm also self-taught in the nuances of anime culture and technology trends, with a penchant for exploring new games and gadgets.
